results.title: Lovable says it added $100M in revenue last month alone, with just 146 employees | TechCrunch
results.author: Anna Heim
highlights:
That overarching message is one of the factors that have helped Lovable attract some 8 million users and become a unicorn in less than a year after its launch. But the prospect that it could also secure enterprise dollars likely played a key role in boosting its valuation to $6.6 billion.

More than half of Fortune 500 companies are using Lovable to “supercharge creativity,” co-founder and CEO Anton Osika declared at Web Summit last November. The company has added a range of dedicated features — often security-related — to convince businesses to use it for more than prototyping and keep them from canceling over time.

...

Its most recent user spike was tied to a specific promotion — Lovable’s SheBuilds initiative for International Women’s Day on March 8, when the whole platform was free for one day. “We saw various records set,” the company told TechCrunch. “One we’re most proud of is that over 500,000 projects were built or updated on Lovable that day (compared to a typical daily average of [approximately] 200,000).”

Also notable is the fact that Lovable achieved $400 million ARR with only 146 full-time employees, as chief revenue officer Ryan Meadows told Business Insider. The company now plans to increase its headcount — and there’s room for it. Its recently inaugurated space in Stockholm has space for 300 people, and the company is also hiring in Boston, London, New York, San Francisco, and remotely.

results.title: Lovable Deep Dive 2026: $13.3B Valuation, $600M+ ARR
results.author: Trace Cohen
highlights:
## Company Snapshot

$13.3B up from $6.6B in Dec 2025 Valuation (Aug 2026)

~$952.5M across 5 rounds since 2024 Total funding raised

2023 Stockholm, Sweden Founded

$600M+ up from $200M in Nov 2025 Run-rate revenue (Sep 2026)

Figures compiled from tech.eu, TechCrunch, Bloomberg, Dealroom, and TheNextWeb reporting, as of October 2026. Lovable is private and does not publish audited financials.

Founders

Anton Osika (CEO), Fabian Hedin (CTO)

HQ

Stockholm, Sweden

Public launch

November 2024 (as Lovable, from the GPT Engineer project)

Headcount

146 confirmed Feb 2026; LinkedIn-derived trackers put it over 1,000 by Sept 2026 — no current figure confirmed by the company

Key investors

Menlo Ventures, EQT Scaleup Europe Fund, Accel, CapitalG, Tencent

Sector

AI / Vibe Coding / App Builder

Projects created

60M+ as of Aug 2026, per company disclosure

Reported users

8M+ as of Nov 2025 (no updated count disclosed since)

...

Lovable is a “vibe coding” platform: a user describes what they want in plain language, and Lovable's AI generates a working web app — frontend, backend, and a connected Supabase database — then deploys it to a live URL within minutes. The user keeps iterating by chatting with the AI rather than writing code directly, with a visual edit mode for people who want to tweak layout without prompting.

...

That enterprise push shows up in the numbers co-founder Fabian Hedin gave on stage at HumanX Amsterdam on September 24, 2026: roughly two-thirds of the Fortune 500 now use Lovable in some capacity, and apps built on the platform draw on the order of 1 billion visits a month. Those are the kind of adoption figures that answer the standard bear case against vibe-coding tools — that they are consumer toys with no durable enterprise demand — even though neither figure has been independently audited.

...

Headcount itself is the one figure with no reliable current number: the 146-employee count is the last company-linked figure on record, from February 2026, while LinkedIn-derived workforce trackers (TipRanks, Autobound) estimated headcount above 1,000 by August and September 2026. Coverage of the Series C separately cited a stated plan to grow headcount roughly 50%, which doesn't reconcile cleanly with either number — so the honest answer is that Lovable's current headcount is not precisely known from public sources.

...

- - Valuation climbed from $1.8B to $13.3B in thirteen months on a private market with no public comparable to check the multiple against.
- - Headcount, user counts, and even the Fortune 500 adoption figure all rest on company-disclosed numbers with no independent audit — the 8M-user figure hasn't been updated since late 2025.
- - No disclosed gross margin or path to profitability; a platform whose heaviest users drive the most revenue through credit top-ups also carries the highest usage-based hosting cost.
- - Lovable has had recurring security-disclosure incidents in 2026, including walking back an initial denial of a data-exposure report in April — a pattern that matters more as enterprise customers run sensitive internal tools on the platform.
- - Replit is growing from a lower base and explicitly targeting $1B ARR by year-end 2026, which would narrow Lovable's revenue lead if it happens.

## How Many People Use Lovable?

Lovable has nearly 8 million users according to the latest data available**.** CEO Anton Osika confirmed these numbers to TechCrunch in November 2025. 

Earlier that year (in July 2025), the platform had 2.3 million active users and 180,000 paying subscribers. This is a huge jump of 5.7 million in just 5 months. 

Lovable hasn’t shared updated user counts for 2026 yet, but what we do know is that over 200,000 new projects get built on the platform every day (as per TIME). The company also says users create more than 1 million new projects every week.

By August 2026, the total project count had crossed 60 million (an all-time record). All those apps and websites built on Lovable pull in about 900 million monthly visitors combined.

On the community side, Lovable has over 174,000 members in its Discord. The original GPT Engineer open-source repo still holds 55,000+ GitHub stars.

results.title: Lovable Reached $400M ARR Faster Than Any Software Company... | TechFastForward
results.author: TechFastForward Desk
highlights:
Key Takeaways

- $400M ARR in 20 months, The fastest ARR growth in software history, doubling from $200M ARR in just three months
- $330M Series B at $6.6B valuation, Led by CapitalG and Menlo Ventures with strategic backing from NVIDIA, Salesforce, Databricks, and Atlassian
- 25 million projects with 100,000+ new daily, A training data flywheel that no competitor can replicate from scratch
- 8 million users as of February 2026, Up from 2.3 million at Series B close, the largest non-developer software creation community ever assembled
- Enterprise strategics as investors, Salesforce, Atlassian, and HubSpot investing signals Lovable is a structural force in enterprise software creation

...

Lovable was founded in 2023 by Anton Osika and Fabian Hedin, who had previously built GPT Engineer, an open-source command-line app generator that accumulated 40,000 GitHub stars in two months, one of the fastest-growing repositories in GitHub history. In November 2024, they relaunched with a GUI-based product under the Lovable brand: an AI-powered full-stack app builder where users describe what they want in plain language and the platform generates working applications complete with database, authentication, and deployment. The "vibe-coding" paradigm it popularized means no formal programming knowledge required, you iterate by conversation until the product does what you need.

...

- 8 million users as of February 2026, Up from 2.3 million at Series B close, representing the largest non-developer software creation community ever assembled
- Enterprise strategics are the investors, Salesforce, Atlassian, and HubSpot participating signals they view Lovable as a structural force in enterprise software creation, not a consumer trend to dismiss
